ec79595a915154b04d9a3783dce9ccbf9200f366.sourceText:
* 提示用户输入一个高考考试分数，根据分数做如下判断
* 分数如果大于600分视为考上一本，大于500分考上二本，大于400考上三本，其余视为未考上本科；
* 在一本分数中，如果大于700分，考入北大，大于650分，考入清华，大于600考入人大。
ec79595a915154b04d9a3783dce9ccbf9200f366.translatedText:
* Prompt the user to enter a college entrance examination score, and make the following judgments based on the score\.
* If the score is greater than 600, it is considered admission to a first\-tier university; if greater than 500, admission to a second\-tier university; if greater than 400, admission to a third\-tier university; otherwise, it is considered not admitted to an undergraduate program\.
* Among first\-tier university scores, if greater than 700, admission to Peking University; if greater than 650, admission to Tsinghua University; if greater than 600, admission to Renmin University of China\.
